Porter's Immortal Cultivation: I Have Level 5 Full Inscriptions

挑夫修仙：我有5级满铭文

Author: 佚名
Read Chapter 1 Add to Library
332 Chapters Ongoing Status
Categories
  • Wuxia Xianxia
About Chapters

Summary

Awakening to the mystery of his birth, Yang Silang felt an immense pressure on his shoulders. It wasn't a figure of speech; he truly felt he was carrying a hundred-pound weight, laboriously traversing the mountain city's steps, unable to rest for a moment to survive. In his previous life, he harbored resentment as a 996 workaholic on Earth, and now, reborn as a porter under the rule of the Great Shun Kingdom, his condition was even more precarious. Just look at this wretched working environment—a turbulent dynasty, greedy officials, violent gangs, unscrupulous guilds, and even high-level martial arts, cults, demonic beasts, and supernatural beings… Yang Silang truly felt his three-foot-long bamboo pole couldn't bear so many mountains. Fortunately, he discovered he was born with several fully-enhanced runes. The Wind rune allowed him to move swiftly even carrying heavy loads; the Earth rune made him thick-skinned and impervious to heat and cold; the Water rune nourished his body and eliminated fatigue; the Fire rune multiplied his burst of power, pushing him beyond his current physical limits. But what surprised him most was the cumulative effect of the Wood rune—a 20% increase in lifespan! Yang Silang had a plan in mind. With these inscriptions by his side, what did it matter if he started with a bamboo carrying pole? These inscriptions, given to a porter, would only be enough to forge a top-quality ox or horse. But what if he switched careers to learn martial arts and cultivate supernatural powers? As long as he persevered in his cultivation, one day he could carry two mountains on his shoulders and become the Great Sage Who Carries Mountains.
